newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean steel stocks hit by rising stockpile.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean steel stocks hit by rising stockpile.

text.p: Shares of Korean steelmakers fell on Thursday on news that inventories of domestic steel products had reached record levels, brokers said.
The steel sub-index fell 14.95 points, or 1.14 percent, to 1,294.14 by midday.

The Korea Iron and Steel Association said on Thursday the stockpile of steel products had reached a historical high of 2.15 million tonnes at the end of July, compared with 1.55 million tonnes a year earlier.
Analysts attributed the rising inventory to production expansion and a slump in domestic home building.
Pohang Iron and Steel lost 800 won to 47,200 and Inchon Iron and Steel fell 300 won to 19,300.
"They fell mainly on consolidation of large-cap shares. But the news also gave an adverse impact on the share prices," said a LG Securities broker. -- Seoul Newsroom (822) 727 5647
